name: Anantara Kihavah Maldives Villas
insider_take: This isn't just another overwater villa resort – it's home to the Maldives' first underwater restaurant and observatory, where you'll dine 20 feet below sea level surrounded by vibrant marine life.
whats_special: Anantara Kihavah sits on the pristine Baa Atoll UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve, offering unparalleled access to manta ray and whale shark encounters. The resort features the world's only glass-walled underwater wine cellar and hosts resident marine biologists who lead exclusive snorkeling expeditions to untouched coral gardens.
pro_tip: Book dinner at SEA (the underwater restaurant) during new moon phases when bioluminescent plankton creates a magical light show around the glass walls – it's a once-in-a-lifetime dining experience.
dont_miss: The overwater Sky Bar with its retractable roof for stargazing, and the resort's signature "Dining by Design" experiences on remote sandbanks. Time your visit between May and November for the best manta ray sightings at nearby Hanifaru Bay.
pros: World's first underwater wine cellar and restaurant experience
Overwater villas with private pools and direct lagoon access
UNESCO Biosphere Reserve location with pristine coral reefs
Observatory with resident marine biologist and telescope stargazing
cons: Remote island location requiring seaplane transfers
